transformation: All source features retained. Properties limited to ADM0_A3 as code and NAME_EN/NAME as name. Coordinates rounded to three decimal places; collapsed rings retain greater source precision. Consecutive duplicate positions removed. No inferred geometry, road or parcel data added.
limits: Generalized geographic overview; some small states and islands are absent. Numeric precision does not establish surveyed positional accuracy. No street, city, provincial or cadastral detail. Natural Earth uses de facto country boundaries.
delivery: Static same-origin file. No visitor-specific URLs, external tiles, glyphs or sprites.
